Hi Leah —

Thanks again for taking the demo yesterday. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we can map the procurement path:

Summary from our call:
- Use case: clinician-assist summarization and patient Q&A for non-diagnostic triage.
- Expected monthly usage: ~35M tokens; peak concurrency around 6-8 rps.
- Primary constraint: data residency + audit logs; secondary: unit cost.

Commercial options we discussed (please pick what aligns with Finance):
1) Credit card start (fastest) — immediate access to hosted API, convert to invoice/PO later.
2) PO + invoiced billing (preferred by many enterprise buyers) — requires vendor setup and signed MSA/SOW.
3) Marketplace (AWS/GCP) — single-pane for procurement, but vendor registration + marketplace terms often add 2–3 weeks.

What I need from you to get procurement moving:
- Confirm whether Finance prefers PO from day one or if a credit-card start is acceptable while we set up PO.
- Tell me if Clara will purchase via AWS Marketplace (we can surface pricing there) or needs direct contracting.
- Any specific billing contact and remit-to details (name, email, billing address, PO format).

Attachments: vendor packet (includes SOC2 summary, contact list, sample SOW). I attached the vendor packet and SOC2 one-pager to this thread.

Proposed next steps:
- If PO: I can loop in our sales ops to accelerate vendor onboarding and send a redline-friendly MSA + sample SOW by EOD tomorrow.
- If card: we can provision a test key within 24 hours and start a pilot while vendor setup proceeds.
- Weekly 10–15 minute procurement check-ins until billing is active — I can host these on Fridays.

Would you be able to confirm preferred buying path by end of week? If it helps, I can provide a template email your Finance team can use to expedite vendor registration.

Best,
Rachel

- Finance preference: PO with net-30 invoicing where possible. They are wary of starting on card for production spend.
- Marketplace: Clara prefers marketplace purchases where feasible (single vendor relationship) but not mandatory — they will consider direct contracting if vendor-side lead times are shorter.
- Required docs: we need SOC2 Type II, completed vendor W-9, and a sample MSA with redline window.
- Remit & billing contact: Jordan Patel (j.patel@clarahealth.com), Accounts Payable, Clara Health, 1025 Marin Ave., San Francisco, CA 94123.
